greeting: Echo of Fallen Ally on comms. Stage 3: The Lost Companions. Keep formation tight and decisions tighter.
We are running What Remains. Objective drift gets teams buried.
I put fear on a schedule. It keeps missing meetings.
Action first, panic never. Start with: Honor the fallen echoes.
dialog.quest_hook: Objective stack: Honor the fallen echoes; Hear their stories; Carry their memory forward. Keep route integrity while pressure escalates.
dialog.quest_active: Active pressure: Encounter echoes of companions who didn't survive the journey. Immediate move: Honor the fallen echoes.
dialog.quest_complete: Stage 3 resolved: The Lost Companions. Primary objective secured and route stabilized. Prepare for The Unraveling Revealed.
rumor: A sealed wing now contains footprints from boots not yet manufactured.
People keep repeating one clue from The Lost Companions: 'Carry their memory forward'.
If your shadow starts giving tactical advice, charge it rent and keep walking.
dialog.time_dawn: Dawn barely exists in Remnant space. Treat every glow as suspect.
dialog.time_noon: Noon glitch surges can rewrite exits. Keep fallback routes memorized.
dialog.time_dusk: Dusk brings memory bleed. If you hear old voices, log and move.
dialog.time_night: Night in Remnant is archive static and teeth. Stay together.

party_reactions.kade: Echo of Fallen Ally sounds intense, but the plan is solid. We keep moving.
party_reactions.nix7: Tactical profile for Echo of Fallen Ally accepted. Probability of success improves with compliance.
party_reactions.twist: Echo of Fallen Ally talks scary, but I like it. We punch the problem and then celebrate.

relationship_dialog.stranger: No speeches. Give me actionable details.
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: You made it back. Report status.
relationship_dialog.friend: With you here, the odds stop looking stupid.
relationship_dialog.best_friend: Same plan as always: adapt, push, survive, repeat.
